info.about: Kid Dracula is a 1993 platformer video game developed and published by Konami for the Game Boy. It is a spinoff of the Castlevania series and a sequel to the 1990 Famicom game also titled Kid Dracula.
info.why: Konami printed the 1993 North American release in small numbers, making it one of the scarcest licensed Game Boy cartridges.
